text: Additional evidence 2026-08-03: OlsSuite basis-reparameterization test passes 15/15 on JVM and 15/15 on Scala.js, covering fitted-value invariance, coefficient transport, normalized covariance transport, and adjusted linear contrast estimate/variance. The remaining Phase 1 caveats are independent R/Nilearn design-oracle receipts, cross-solver row-space/residual comparisons for rank-deficient scenarios, and broader planned scenario coverage.
